QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Shrine Tales] The Grieving Grotto
QuestInfo.0: Many Specters gather at Grieving Grotto in western Zipangu. You should investigate whether it's related to the Water Element.
QuestInfo.1: Many Specters gather at Grieving Grotto in western Zipangu. You should investigate whether it's related to the Water Element.
QuestInfo.2: The many Specters gathered at Grieving Grotto in western Zipangu seem to be worshiping an individual known as #p9111004#. According to Daidarabotchi's vision, #p9111004# has the Water Element, but there seems to be no way to approach him.
